bible_verses.telugu: ఆ దూతలు తమయొద్దనుండి పరలోకమునకు  వెళ్లిన తరువాత ఆ గొఱ్ఱల కాపరులుజరిగిన యీ కార్యమును ప్రభువు మనకు తెలియజేయించి యున్నాడు; మనము బేత్లెహేమువరకు వెళ్లి చూతము రండని యొకనితో         నొకడు చెప్పుకొని
bible_verses.english: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, 'Let’s go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about.'

bible_verses.telugu: తల్లియైన మరియను ఆ శిశువును చూచి, సాగిలపడి, ఆయనను పూజించి, తమ పెట్టెలు విప్పి, బంగారమును సాంబ్రాణిని బోళమును కానుకలుగా ఆయనకు సమర్పించిరి.
bible_verses.english: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన మన దేవుడు మనము ఆయన పాలించు ప్రజలము ఆయన మేపు గొఱ్ఱలము.
bible_verses.english: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for inviting me to draw near to You today. I come with a heart full of gratitude and wonder, eager to behold Your beauty and grace. Help me to set aside my distractions and offer You my genuine adoration. May my life sing Your praises alongside the hosts of heaven. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for inviting me to draw near to You today. I come with a heart full of gratitude and wonder, eager to behold Your beauty and grace. Help me to set aside my distractions and offer You my genuine adoration. May my life sing Your praises alongside the hosts of heaven. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: This beloved hymn extends a warm invitation to step away from the noise of the world and draw near to Jesus in simple, heartfelt worship. Like the shepherds on that holy night, we are called to behold our King—not with distant curiosity, but with joyful hearts ready to adore Him. Jesus warmly welcomes everyone who seeks Him, meeting us with His grace and light. Today, let us answer this gentle call together and pour out our sincere devotion to Christ the Lord.
